correctness.rationale: Rebuilt the invariant quadratic reduction A -> B=(A+A#)/2, polar conjugation B=JQ with Q=(B^2)^1/2, absolute quadratic estimate and positive Ky Fan rank-k variational maximum. At a=sigma_k(Q), finite-rank E_Q((a,infinity)) and equality in the trace bound give the exact boundary condition dim E_Q([a,infinity))>=k. Complex Stiefel path-connectivity, phase rotation and explicit Takagi zero frames for even k and both odd-k cases fill the disk; consecutive Ky Fan sums recover sigma_k, essential norm compactness and Schatten membership. Correctly excludes dimension one and cannot recover skew-adjoint antilinear part. Our independent n=2..8 orthonormal-frame tests confirmed random-frame upper bounds, zero-frame pair construction and finite spectrum formula, not infinite proof.
